title: Bell of Creation
description: A surreal painting shows a long-haired woman kneeling in a dark rocky landscape, catching small sculpted figures and fragments falling from a giant cracked bell suspended above her. Inside the bell a cherubic child with a hammer strikes its interior while a large scroll with faint drawings floats in the sky and an anvil with cloth and tools rests nearby.
prompt: surreal scene of a long-haired woman in a dark robe kneeling on the ground with hands outstretched, catching small sculpted human figures and broken pieces falling from a giant cracked bronze bell hanging in the sky, inside the bell a golden cherub child sits holding a hammer, large illustrated scroll floating above, anvil with white cloth and sculpting tools on the ground, dramatic twilight lighting, mystical atmosphere
